display_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-07-D3-11 Demonstration of hydropower technologies for efficient and forward-looking refurbishment of existing hydropower plants – Horizon Europe
call_module_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-07-D3-11 Demonstration of hydropower technologies for efficient and forward-looking refurbishment of existing hydropower plants
executive_summary: Demonstrates ways to refurbish existing hydropower plants and improve flexible output, fleet controls, grid integration and climate resilience. Eligible consortium beneficiaries can receive up to 70% for for-profit beneficiaries under Horizon Europe. The indicative topic budget is EUR 17 million, with around EUR 8.5 million expected per project. Opening 2027-08-04, full proposal deadline 2027-12-01 at 17:00 Brussels time.
status_rationale: Work Programme Part 8, pp. 143–144, Specific conditions and Scope, funds lump-sum Innovation Actions that demonstrate refurbishment technologies for existing hydropower plants: turbines, generators, materials, digital controls and water management. It touches TenneT's field only through the expected outcome on modernised grid integration and fleet control, which relates to flexible generation supporting grid stability, as in the Time-dependent transmission rights contract (Lion Storage). The call sets out no route for TenneT: the work takes place at hydropower plants, which TenneT neither owns nor has on its Dutch grid, and the scope establishes no grid-operator work package. C3.3 fits because more flexible hydropower supports balancing and system stability through others. Both project dates are null because the call states no start, end or duration.
